name: Rust 30
notes: Corrosion as a coverage family: nine stages of the same panel rusting, 10%..90% of core-band stroke pixels inked. The levels are NESTED - each stage's rust strictly contains the last - because all nine tips are thresholds of one two-band field (tips/rust.spec.json): a bloom band (spread patches, shoulder ~2.5 c/dia) plus a fine pitting band (~22 c/dia) at 0.4x its octave variance, which puts pit-ragged fringes and satellite specks on every patch boundary. Architecture, train and calibration are the oil-sponge dual-gate verbatim (see brushes/oil-sponge-50.json and docs/fractal-texture-math.md): the mask multiplies the finished stroke once, so patch voids survive the paint train. Verified by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs: no comb, no spikes, isotropic. Distinct corrosion patches with pit-speckled fringes; sound metal still dominates.
